beats.care: Leave early, avoid flood-prone underpasses, and skip standing under trees when it thunders. Check routes before evening rides.
beats.what: IMD warns of thunderstorms with lightning today, and heavy rain from October 21 to 23 across south interior Karnataka, including Bengaluru.
beats.why: The northeast monsoon is bringing rain to south India. Bengaluru Urban is on yellow alert, Bengaluru Rural on orange, reports say.

cards.body: The road below the upcoming Hulimavu metro station flooded again on Saturday. Residents say the drain is still blocked.
cards.caption: water on Bannerghatta Road at Hulimavu

cards.body: Residents say GBA chief commissioner M Maheshwar Rao ordered the drain fixed back in May. Arakere Lake sits right next to the road, yet water still collects there.
cards.title: A fix that never came

opts: Stay aware, weather may turn bad
cards.q: What does IMD's yellow alert ask you to do?
cards.why: Yellow is IMD's 'be aware' level; orange means be prepared and red means take action.

cards.q: How do you handle rainy commutes?

cards.body: Bengaluru Rural, next door, is on a higher orange alert for heavy to very heavy rain, even though the city itself is on yellow.

hook: Why should you *keep an umbrella handy* this week?

learn.t: IMD puts Bengaluru in 'South Interior Karnataka', one of the state's three weather subdivisions with coastal and north interior.
